mapper.select: SELECT * FROM crm_schedule WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND start_at < DATE_ADD(#{end},INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND end_at >= #{start} ORDER BY start_at,id
mapper.sql:
SELECT NULL AS id,'' AS kind,'' AS title,'' AS reason,NULL AS due_at,'' AS task_type WHERE 1=0
UNION ALL SELECT l.id,'LEAD',l.company_name,'线索跟进',l.next_follow_at,'LEAD_FOLLOW' FROM crm_lead l LEFT JOIN sys_user o ON o.id=l.owner_id JOIN sys_user a ON a.id=l.created_by WHERE l.owner_id IS NOT NULL AND l.status='CONTACTING' AND l.next_follow_at IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL SELECT c.id,'CUSTOMER',c.company_name,'客户跟进',c.next_follow_at,'CUSTOMER_FOLLOW' FROM crm_customer c LEFT JOIN sys_user o ON o.id=c.owner_id WHERE c.owner_id IS NOT NULL AND c.next_follow_at IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL SELECT l.id,'LEAD',l.company_name,'待分配线索',l.created_at,'ASSIGN' FROM crm_lead l WHERE l.owner_id IS NULL AND l.status='PENDING' AND l.target_dept_id IN #{d}AND 1=0
UNION ALL SELECT c.id,'CUSTOMER',c.company_name,'待审核公海申请',pr.created_at,'REVIEW' FROM crm_pool_request pr JOIN crm_customer c ON c.id=pr.customer_id LEFT JOIN sys_user o ON o.id=c.owner_id WHERE pr.status='PENDING' AND c.owner_id IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL SELECT a.id,'AFTERSALE',CONCAT(c.company_name,' · ',a.title),'售后跟进',a.next_follow_at,'AFTERSALE_FOLLOW' FROM crm_aftersale a JOIN crm_customer c ON c.id=a.customer_id LEFT JOIN sys_user o ON o.id=c.owner_id WHERE a.status<>'CLOSED' AND a.next_follow_at IS NOT NULL
